description.sk: Cesnak, olivový olej a štipka čili – večera za 15 minút.
description.en: Garlic, olive oil and a pinch of chili: dinner in 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Špagety uvar v osolenej vode al dente podľa návodu, zvyčajne 9 minút. Odlož si hrnček vody z varenia.
steps.en: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, usually 9 minutes. Save a cup of the cooking water.

steps.sk: Medzitým na olivovom oleji na miernom ohni opekaj cesnak nakrájaný na tenké plátky s čili vločkami, kým cesnak nie je svetlozlatý (nie hnedý).
steps.en: Meanwhile, gently fry the thinly sliced garlic with the chili flakes in the olive oil until the garlic is pale golden (not brown).

steps.sk: Špagety prelož do panvice, pridaj trochu vody z varenia a premiešavaj, kým sa olej s vodou nespojí do lesklej omáčky.
steps.en: Transfer the spaghetti to the pan, add a splash of cooking water and toss until the oil and water come together into a glossy sauce.

steps.sk: Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podľa chuti parmezánom.
steps.en: Sprinkle with parsley and, if you like, parmesan.

description.sk: Lacné cestoviny zo špajze s množstvom bielkovín.
description.en: Cheap pantry pasta packed with protein.

steps.sk: Daj variť cestoviny do osolenej vody podľa návodu.
steps.en: Put the pasta on to cook in salted water according to the packet.

steps.sk: Na olivovom oleji speň nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, asi 5 minút, potom pridaj cesnak na minútu.
steps.en: Soften the finely chopped onion in the olive oil for about 5 minutes, then add the garlic for a minute.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky, pridaj oregano, soľ a korenie a nechaj 10 minút prebublávať.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper and let it bubble for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj odkvapkaného tuniaka, len ho prehrej a zmiešaj s uvarenými cestovinami.
steps.en: Stir in the drained tuna, just warm it through and toss with the cooked pasta.

steps.sk: Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Sprinkle with parsley. Keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Krémové rizoto bez smotany – stačí trpezlivo miešať.
description.en: A creamy risotto with no cream: just patient stirring.

steps.sk: Bujóny rozpusti v 1,2 l horúcej vody a vývar udržiavaj horúci.
steps.en: Dissolve the stock cubes in 1.2 l hot water and keep the stock hot.

steps.sk: Na oleji opeč nakrájané huby na prudkom ohni dozlatista, asi 6 minút, a odlož ich.
steps.en: Fry the sliced mushrooms in the oil over high heat until golden, about 6 minutes, and set aside.

steps.sk: V tom istom hrnci speň na polovici masla cibuľu, pridaj cesnak a ryžu a 2 minúty opekaj, kým zrnká na okrajoch nesklovatejú.
steps.en: In the same pot, soften the onion in half the butter, add the garlic and rice and toast for 2 minutes until the grains turn translucent at the edges.

steps.sk: Podlej vínom a nechaj ho odpariť. Potom prilievaj vývar po naberačkách a miešaj, kým ho ryža nevsiakne. Opakuj asi 18 minút, kým ryža nie je krémová a v strede ešte jemne pevná.
steps.en: Add the wine and let it evaporate. Then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring until it is absorbed. Repeat for about 18 minutes, until the rice is creamy but still slightly firm in the centre.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj huby, zvyšné maslo a strúhaný parmezán, okoreň a nechaj 2 minúty prikryté odpočinúť.
steps.en: Stir in the mushrooms, the remaining butter and the grated parmesan, season with pepper and let it rest, covered, for 2 minutes.

description.sk: Poctivé zapekané lasagne s mäsovou omáčkou a bešamelom – ideálne na celý týždeň.
description.en: Proper baked lasagne with meat sauce and béchamel: ideal for the whole week.

steps.sk: Na olivovom oleji speň nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a nastrúhanú mrkvu, asi 5 minút. Pridaj cesnak.
steps.en: Soften the finely chopped onion and grated carrot in the olive oil for about 5 minutes. Add the garlic.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso a opekaj ho na prudkom ohni, kým nie je nikde ružové, asi 8 minút. Hrudky rozbíjaj vareškou.
steps.en: Add the beef and brown it over high heat until it is no longer pink anywhere, about 8 minutes, breaking up the lumps with a spoon.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj pretlak, passatu, oregano, 1 lyžičku soli a korenie a nechaj prikryté dusiť na miernom ohni 30 minút.
steps.en: Stir in the tomato paste, passata, oregano, 1 teaspoon of salt and the pepper and simmer covered over low heat for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Bešamel: na masle krátko opraž múku, postupne vmiešaj studené mlieko a za stáleho miešania var 5 minút, kým nezhustne. Dochuť zvyšnou soľou a muškátovým orieškom.
steps.en: Béchamel: cook the flour in the butter briefly, gradually whisk in the cold milk and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick. Season with the remaining salt and the nutmeg.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Do zapekacej misy vrstvi mäsovú omáčku, pláty lasagní a bešamel; posledná vrstva je bešamel.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Layer meat sauce, lasagne sheets and béchamel in a baking dish, finishing with béchamel.

steps.sk: Posyp parmezánom a natrhanou mozzarellou a peč 40 minút dozlatista. Pred krájaním nechaj 10 minút odpočinúť.
steps.en: Top with the parmesan and torn mozzarella and bake for 40 minutes until golden. Let it rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

description.sk: Hustá talianska zeleninová polievka, ktorá vydrží niekoľko dní.
description.en: A thick Italian vegetable soup that keeps for several days.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, mrkvu a zeler nakrájaj na drobné kocky a nechaj ich na olivovom oleji 8 minút pomaly dusiť.
steps.en: Dice the onion, carrots and celery and cook them gently in the olive oil for 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, kocky zemiakov a cukety, paradajky, bujóny, oregano a 1,5 l vody. Var 15 minút.
steps.en: Add the garlic, diced potato and zucchini, the tomatoes, stock cubes, oregano and 1.5 l water. Simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú fazuľu a cestoviny a var, kým cestoviny nezmäknú, asi 10 minút.
steps.en: Add the rinsed beans and the pasta and simmer until the pasta is tender, about 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Okoreň, podľa bujónu dochuť soľou a podávaj s natrhanou bazalkou.
steps.en: Season with pepper, add salt to taste depending on the stock, and serve with torn basil.

description.sk: Ostrá paradajková omáčka s cesnakom – rastlinná a lacná.
description.en: A fiery tomato and garlic sauce: plant-based and cheap.

steps.sk: Daj variť cestoviny do osolenej vody.
steps.en: Put the pasta on to cook in salted water.

steps.sk: Na olivovom oleji minútu opekaj nakrájaný cesnak s čili vločkami, kým nezavonia.
steps.en: Fry the sliced garlic with the chili flakes in the olive oil for a minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky, osoľ a var 12 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 12 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj s uvarenými cestovinami a trochou vody z varenia a posyp petržlenovou vňaťou.
steps.en: Toss with the cooked pasta and a splash of the cooking water and sprinkle with parsley.

description.sk: Tenké chrumkavé cesto, paradajky, mozzarella a bazalka.
description.en: A thin crisp base with tomatoes, mozzarella and basil.

steps.sk: Múku zmiešaj s droždím, soľou a cukrom, pridaj 190 ml vlažnej vody a lyžicu oleja a miesením 8 minút vypracuj hladké cesto.
steps.en: Mix the flour with the yeast, salt and sugar, add 190 ml lukewarm water and a tablespoon of oil and knead for 8 minutes into a smooth dough.

steps.sk: Prikry a nechaj kysnúť na teplom mieste 1 hodinu, kým nezdvojnásobí objem.
steps.en: Cover and leave to rise somewhere warm for 1 hour until doubled.

steps.sk: Rúru s plechom predhrej na maximum (250 °C). Cesto rozdeľ na 2 časti a rukami roztiahni na tenké placky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven with a baking tray inside to its maximum (250 °C). Divide the dough in two and stretch each into a thin round.

steps.sk: Natri passatou zmiešanou s oreganom, poukladaj natrhanú mozzarellu a pokvapkaj olejom.
steps.en: Spread with the passata mixed with the oregano, top with torn mozzarella and drizzle with oil.

steps.sk: Peč na rozpálenom plechu 8 až 10 minút, kým okraje nie sú zlatohnedé a syr bublá. Posyp bazalkou.
steps.en: Bake on the hot tray for 8–10 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the cheese bubbles. Scatter with basil.

description.sk: Krémová omáčka len z vajec a syra, bez smotany.
description.en: A creamy sauce made only from eggs and cheese, no cream.

steps.sk: Špagety uvar v osolenej vode al dente a odlož si hrnček vody z varenia.
steps.en: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente and keep a cup of the cooking water.

steps.sk: Slaninu nakrájaj na prúžky a opeč na suchej panvici do chrumkava.
steps.en: Cut the bacon into strips and fry in a dry pan until crisp.

steps.sk: Vajcia vyšľahaj so strúhaným parmezánom a veľa korenia.
steps.en: Whisk the eggs with the grated parmesan and plenty of pepper.

steps.sk: Panvicu stiahni z ohňa, pridaj sceďené špagety a nechaj ich minútu trochu vychladnúť.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat, add the drained spaghetti and let it cool for a minute.

steps.sk: Vlej vajíčkovú zmes s trochou vody z varenia a rýchlo miešaj, kým sa nevytvorí krémová omáčka. Ak by vajcia začali zrážať, pridaj ďalšiu vodu.
steps.en: Pour in the egg mixture with a splash of cooking water and toss quickly until a creamy sauce forms. If the eggs start to scramble, add more water.

description.sk: Ľahké, no sýte guľky s množstvom bielkovín.
description.en: Light but filling meatballs packed with protein.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj s vajcom, strúhankou, parmezánom, 1 strúčikom cesnaku, polovicou soli a korením a vytvaruj 20 guliek.
steps.en: Mix the turkey with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, 1 garlic clove, half the salt and the pepper and shape into 20 balls.

steps.sk: Na oleji guľky opeč zo všetkých strán dozlatista, asi 6 minút, a odlož ich.
steps.en: Brown the meatballs all over in the oil, about 6 minutes, and set aside.

steps.sk: Na tom istom oleji speň cibuľu so zvyšným cesnakom, prilej passatu, pridaj oregano a zvyšnú soľ.
steps.en: Soften the onion with the remaining garlic in the same pan, add the passata, oregano and remaining salt.

steps.sk: Vráť guľky do omáčky a nechaj prikryté dusiť 15 minút, kým nie sú prepečené a vnútri bez ružovej farby (74 °C).
steps.en: Return the meatballs to the sauce and simmer covered for 15 minutes until cooked through with no pink inside (74 °C).

steps.sk: Posyp bazalkou a podávaj samotné alebo so špagetami.
steps.en: Sprinkle with basil and serve on their own or with spaghetti.
